site.name: Crumb & Bloom
site.description: A cheerful neighborhood bakery on Alder Street.

/.title: A little joy, baked daily
/.description: Slow-fermented loaves, sunny pastries, and very good coffee—made for neighbors, morning wanderers, and anyone who saved room for a treat.

/menu/.title: Today’s bake
/menu/.description: Our everyday favorites, plus a few things inspired by the farms, gardens, and good moods around us.

/story/.title: Rooted in the neighborhood
/story/.description: Crumb & Bloom began with a borrowed mixer, a market stall, and the idea that a bakery can feel like the brightest room on the block.

/journal/.title: Notes from the bakehouse
/journal/.description: Small stories about slow dough, bright fruit, early mornings, and the neighbors who keep our ovens busy.

/journal/slow-mornings/.title: Why good bread takes the long way
/journal/slow-mornings/.description: A loaf spends most of its life waiting. That unhurried time is where the flavor, texture, and character arrive.

/journal/seasonal-jam/.title: The jam jar follows the weather
/journal/seasonal-jam/.description: Our pastry case changes when the orchards do. Here’s how a crate of ripe fruit becomes the week’s brightest bake.

/order/.title: A cake worth gathering around
/order/.description: Build a celebration cake in five small steps, then pick it up fresh from our Alder Street bakehouse.

/order/cake/.title: How many forks?
/order/cake/.description: Start with the size of your table. We’ll make sure there’s enough cake for everyone.

/order/cake/flavor/.title: Choose your flavors
/order/cake/flavor/.description: Pick a cake and filling. Every combination gets vanilla bean buttercream and a little seasonal flourish.

/order/cake/finish/.title: Make it yours
/order/cake/finish/.description: Choose the finishing touches that make the cake feel like it belongs at your table.

/order/cake/pickup/.title: When should it be ready?
/order/cake/pickup/.description: We bake celebration cakes Thursday through Sunday and ask for three days’ notice.

/order/cake/review/.title: Everything look delicious?
/order/cake/review/.description: Review the cake we’ve built together before sending the order to the bakehouse.

/visit/.title: Come by for something warm
/visit/.description: We’re a five-minute stroll from Alder Park. There’s a sunny window seat, a water bowl for dogs, and usually a loaf with your name on it.

journal_entries.title: Why good bread takes the long way
journal_entries.excerpt: Cold nights, patient dough, and the quiet work behind our everyday sourdough.

journal_entries.title: The jam jar follows the weather
journal_entries.excerpt: From the first strawberries to late-summer plums, the fruit gets the final say.

values.title: Made for today
values.description: Small batches mean the bread is fresh and the menu can follow the season.

values.title: Close to home
values.description: We choose local flour, fruit, dairy, coffee, and collaborators whenever we can.

values.title: Everyone is welcome
values.description: Warm service, fair work, generous tables, and a treat for the dog waiting outside.
